data.description: Producers World Cup 2022 - Indonesia stands for a track which made by Autodepth, Arya, Alva Gracia and Taf. Consists 3 different drops, this track unpredicted was finished only 2 hours and 30 minutes, professionally mixed and mastered. While the team put low expectation to getting qualified on the next round, trusting on process by putting a lot of efforts while the track was made is one of the key to gain each other chemistry to build this track. The team presented you, 126 BPM track.
